purpose: Routes routine, private and schema-bound work locally; escalates only long-horizon work.
Turns repositories into bounded evidence packets rather than prompt avalanches.
Validates JSON locally and repairs cloud output through a local verifier.
Typed, allowlisted and auditable tools with workspace boundaries.
Caps steps, retries, repeated tool signatures and cloud branches.
Records model choices, tool calls, masked results, gates and artifacts.
Separates diagnosis, plan, patch, validation and rollback.
Forbids success claims without objective verification.
Operational prompts in pt-BR, English, Spanish and French.
Protects the high-usage cloud allowance from trivial work.
Persists compact checkpoints for interrupted long tasks.
Checks host, versions, models and optional capabilities before execution.
Compares clean baselines, stashes, caches and bundlers to attribute failures.
Combines cost, market, demand and product evidence into pricing scenarios.
